criteria.name: section_coverage
criteria.reason: Summarizes all main sections effectively, providing a comprehensive overview.

criteria.name: concision
criteria.reason: Sections are concise and clear, though minor details could be trimmed for even greater clarity.

criteria.name: faithfulness
criteria.reason: All ideas accurately reflect the content of the original paper without hallucinations.

criteria.name: writing_quality
criteria.reason: Generally well-written with clear language and coherence; minor grammatical improvements possible.

overall_reason: The summary is accurate, comprehensive, and concise, effectively capturing the essence of the paper.
